value: While the reference screen is entirely solid white, our emulator renders a dark gray band across the top and a black background below filled with scattered stars and small gray saucer-like shapes.

In the bottom half of the screen, the horizontal line and the "HALOGEN PRESS START" text overlay are missing and replaced by stars and UFOs, while the bottom edge of the top gray band is also slightly shifted.

In our frame, the bottom edge of the top grey band is one pixel higher across the left and middle of the screen, and a small white dash on the right edge in the lower-middle section is shifted down by one pixel.
Along the bottom edge of the upper gray band, a single-pixel horizontal strip stretching from the left side across most of the screen is black in our frame instead of gray as in the reference.
Along the bottom edge of the top gray band, the left and middle sections are missing one row of gray pixels, making the boundary flat instead of extending one pixel lower than the far right end.
Along the bottom edge of the top gray band, a single-pixel-high horizontal strip stretching from the left edge across most of the screen is black instead of gray.

Along the bottom edge of the top grey band, on the left and middle-left sides above the enemy rows, a thin horizontal line of pixels differs in shade and shows two short grey dashes sticking down into the black background.
